bagPolicy.summary: Bags no larger than 5” x 9” are permitted, along with diaper and medical bags, which are subject to search upon entry. Strollers are not allowed inside Target Center.
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are allowed but subject to search.

parking.note: Parking is available at Ramps A, B, and C, with reservations recommended through SpotHero for discounts up to 50% off. Be aware of ongoing construction affecting I-94 and I-394.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Target Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Target Center offers a diverse range of food options, including new stands and traditional favorites. Highlights include chef-driven dishes, local ingredients, and unique offerings like the French Onion Dog, S’more Nachos, and a variety of international and comfort foods.
stands: 118 Bibigo / Ben’s Pretzels / Maui Wowi & Cold Stone
126 Next Up Kitchen / Walking Taco / Rolling Smoke

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Target Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Target Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Target Center. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Target Center's main gate entrance is located on skyway level.
